\c[DeltaVeryEasy]Enemies are few, timid, and weak. Resources can be found abound; death is very unlikely.\n\nRecommended for players looking for a laidback experience.\c-

\c[DeltaEasy]Enemies deal less damage and are found in fewer numbers. Think fast, and you'll make it out okay. Equivalent to "Hey, Not Too Rough" in Doom.\n\nRecommended for players newer to first person shooters.\c-

The intended way to play. Keep your wits about you and be on guard; your survival may not be guaranteed. Equivalent to "Hurt Me Plenty" in Doom.\n\nRecommended for players who've played a few first person shooters.

\c[DeltaHard]Enemies come in larger numbers, and resources may prove scarce at times. Act with caution--you may be strong, but cockiness will result in a swift death. Equivalent to "Ultra-Violence" in Doom.\n\nRecommended for players who are experienced with first person shooters.\c-

\c[DeltaVeryHard]Enemies hit significantly harder, and are much faster and more aggressive. Well-rounded knowledge of your arsenal, abilities, and their synergies is essential to survival.\n\nRecommended for DeltaWarriors veterans looking for a fresh challenge.\c-
